name: Shelby Zhiho
source:
[i]"We want to return Taozhe to how it used to be."[/i]

[i]Twin who Laments the Past[/i]

Hiyok's friend and a resident of Taozhe. The younger twin to Zhia, who cares deeply about his sister. Compared to his sister's more outgoing personality, he's a bit more introverted.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
